title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Member Benefits Statement
content:
Members of Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards receive the benefits of their tier: a register discount on paint, discounts and waivers in other Ridgeline programs, and, at some tiers, an assigned pro account representative.

## Paint and paint sundries

Members receive the tier's paint discount percentage off paint and paint sundries at the register, until the paint discount taken in the program year reaches the tier's yearly paint discount total. The paint discount taken in the program year is the total paint discount taken at the register on purchases credited in that year, as recorded on the receipts. The credited spend is the amount after the discount.

*Hypothetical:* a member at a tier with a 10 percent paint discount, whose paint discount taken in the program year is still well short of the tier's yearly total, buys USD 400.00 of paint at the register. The discount is USD 40.00, and the qualifying spend credited is USD 360.00.

## Benefits in other Ridgeline programs

The tier's rental discount applies to Ridgeline Tool Rental rental time, the tier's restocking fee waiver to returnable special orders with Ridgeline Special Order Services, and the tier's delivery discount to Ridgeline Orders & Delivery delivery fees, each under the rules of that program and each only while the membership is active on the relevant date.

| Benefit | Applies to | Condition on the membership |
|---|---|---|
| Rental discount | Ridgeline Tool Rental rental time | active on the relevant date |
| Restocking fee waiver | returnable special orders with Ridgeline Special Order Services | active on the relevant date |
| Delivery discount | Ridgeline Orders & Delivery delivery fees | active on the relevant date |

*Hypothetical:* on the relevant date of a Ridgeline Tool Rental rental, the membership is suspended. The tier's rental discount does not apply to that rental time, since the membership is not active on that date.

## Pro account representative

Members at a tier that carries a dedicated account representative are served by an assigned pro account representative.
